subject: k-class
notes: Crew reference photos/video (private), 2026-11; builder general arrangement (private). Photo vessel class is unconfirmed; T-class uses transferred low-confidence photo estimates. Neutral original geometry only. All placements are provisional pending crew measurements. Enclosure floor, roof, width and fore/aft limits are canonical hull-layout datums; the embedded numeric snapshots support builds before the hull files are synced and retain their confidence.

footprint.note: Derived cache: width, roof minus upper deck, fore minus aft. Generator resolves the canonical hull datum fields rather than independent shell estimates.

floor_origin.note: Derived cache: centreline, upper_deck_height, midpoint of fore/aft enclosure limits. Individual vertical confidence is retained in upper_deck_height.

console_size.note: Console height and depth estimated against approximate 0.30 m engine displays; no confirmed equipment model.

panel_height.note: Upper panel above desk; bow visibility requires confirmation of elevated helm seating.

eye_seated.note: x from centreline, y above canonical upper deck, z offset aft of canonical wheelhouse_fore_z. Elevated helm eye estimate adjusted for unobstructed bow sightline; requires crew measurement. Eye moved 0.15 m forward with the helm chair after checking the actual automatic-bow target at 45 percent LOA, retaining the required clear line of sight.

eye_standing.note: x from centreline, y above canonical upper deck, z offset aft of canonical wheelhouse_fore_z. Elevated helm eye estimate adjusted for unobstructed bow sightline; requires crew measurement. Eye moved 0.15 m forward with the helm chair after checking the actual automatic-bow target at 45 percent LOA, retaining the required clear line of sight.

window_sill.note: Height above floor; no glass mesh, exterior owns glazing.

engine_display_size.note: Approximate equipment envelope, not a verified manufacturer dimension.

navigation_display_size.note: Unbranded screen aperture; independent RenderTexture material.

lever_height.note: Twin engine control head handle travel is a visual estimate.

lever_travel.note: Visual only; animation uses normalized applied engine commands.

helm_travel.note: Core has one helm command, no independent NFU mode or jog demand; NFU levers remain neutral.

seat_size.note: Elevated helm seat; aft companion seat placement is provisional.

upper_deck_height.note: Canonical hull datum snapshot from reference-import, 2026-11-08; live sibling hull layout overrides it when present. Unmeasured K-class assumption: estimated main deck 2.5 m plus T-class 2.4 m deck rise. Needs K-class profile.
